facts.fact: Joint Order 50/2024, published on 27 December 2024, declares the phased entry into operation of the SIJ and its criminal-process subsystem SIPP and makes use of the electronic criminal process obligatory in the Polícia Nacional; only the summary is held, not the operative text.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação de Justiça (SIJ), Subsistema de Informação do Processo Penal (SIPP)

facts.fact: The order bringing SIJ and SIPP into operation and binding the Polícia Nacional to the electronic criminal process was issued on 27 December 2024 by the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Internal Administration jointly.
facts.system: Sistema de Informação de Justiça (SIJ), Subsistema de Informação do Processo Penal (SIPP)

systems.system: Sistema de Informação de Justiça (SIJ), Subsistema de Informação do Processo Penal (SIPP)
systems.owner: Ministério da Justiça and Ministério da Administração Interna (joint order)
systems.tiers: phased entry into operation; use obligatory in the Polícia Nacional, with no stations named or counted

note: A legal instrument held as its summary only: it obliges the Polícia Nacional to use the electronic criminal process but does not say how or where the record is made, nor how many stations do so.
